items.question: According to Gallup's Global Law and Order Report 2025, what percentage of the UAE population feels safe walking alone at night?
items.gold: 90 per cent of the population feels safe walking alone at night.
items.fact: Gallup 2025 report: 90% feel safe walking alone

items.question: In the WJP Rule of Law Index 2025, what was the UAE's global rank for how people experience and perceive the rule of law?
items.fact: WJP 2025: UAE ranked 37th globally on rule of law
